  • Constructor Details

    • EnergyNetworkReport

      public EnergyNetworkReport(String busName, List<EnergyAllocation> allocations, double offeredSupply, double acceptedSupply, double requestedDemand, double servedDemand, double unmetDemand, double curtailedSupply, double balancingGeneration, double balancingConsumption, double conversionLoss, double fuelEnergyRate, double operatingCostPerHour, double co2EmissionRate)
      Creates a network report.
      Parameters:
      busName - bus name
      allocations - participant allocations
      offeredSupply - offered supply in W
      acceptedSupply - accepted supply in W
      requestedDemand - requested demand in W
      servedDemand - served demand in W
      unmetDemand - unmet demand in W
      curtailedSupply - curtailed supply in W
      balancingGeneration - balancing generation in W
      balancingConsumption - balancing consumption in W
      conversionLoss - conversion loss in W
      fuelEnergyRate - accepted chemical or fuel energy rate in W
      operatingCostPerHour - operating cost per hour
      co2EmissionRate - CO2-equivalent emission rate in kg/h
